verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation addresses performance benchmarks or item/database caps at scale; the evidence pack only contains generic API docs and community reports describing performance problems (CPU usage, sluggishness, an arbitrary 1000-block limit, and data loss on refresh) that raise doubts rather than confirm behavior at tens-of-thousands-of-task scale. missing for 10: vendor performance benchmarks, documented database/task size limits, and any evidence of tested behavior at tens-of-thousands-of-item scale.
